remarks:
Investor Special or Opportunity to Make It Your Own! Welcome to 12 Leonard Post Drive in Cheektowaga! This 3-
bedroom, 1.5-bath Cape Cod offers a fantastic opportunity for investors, rehabbers, or buyers looking to build
equity through renovations. The property was tenant-occupied for the past eight years and is now vacant,
making it easy to show. Due to the property's condition following the tenancy, the seller has elected to sell the
home strictly AS IS. The seller will make no repairs or replacements for any defects or damages to the property.
Despite the cosmetic work needed, several major improvements have already been completed within the past
five years, including a new roof, replacement windows throughout the home, and a forced-air furnace, providing
a solid foundation for your renovation plans. The home also features a full basement, a detached 2.5-car garage,
and a spacious yard. Conveniently located near schools, shopping, restaurants, parks, and major highways, this
property offers excellent potential for the right buyer. Bring your vision and unlock the possibilities this home
has to offer.
facts: Eat In Kitchen, Bedroom On Main Level
